text:
This page is the causal stack: 00 Astra → 01 Genesis Pin → mid rungs → 08 atlas → 09 Package 17 / gravity candidate. The v13 campaign rungs (00 Full quantum completion → 08 QRSL origin exhausted) are a different ladder. Watch those gates on the live campaign board.

Spradlin’s “simple version” of the work is a causal stack from pure information to geometry-like structure. Nothing in the stack is a spacetime postulate. Each layer is an admissibility or algebraic closure condition in the retained-bridge packages (V1638 full stack, V1686 L3, V1687 L4, V1698 pin init). Astra sits below the pin this week; June 2026 substrate holds V171x instead of duplicating it here.

Pruning-order history

Directed, non-reversible recombination record. Homepage layer 02. The 1 Jun BPI2014 traces are the skip-null: if sequence, provenance, or entropy direction fails, the geometry collapses. UCI 498 showed a pruning-order signal but missed holdout certification — not counted as a win. Status URL 2061513314208010251.

Order-dependent recoverability traces carry geometry-like closure that spatial counterfeits fail when sequence, provenance, entropy arrow, and phase order are jointly enforced. Not GR. UCI 498 remains a near-miss.

Admissible slice

Source, support, and order gates — not just charts. Homepage layer 03. Geometry-like closure only counts as retained when the Genesis/provenance ledger plus those three gates survive. Status URL 2064518917310312599 (it-from-bit, bind, and order).

Source / support / order admissibility is a legitimacy gate on retained atlas closure. Shuffle any one while leaving transition matrices intact and the construction is supposed to fail. Not a cosmological initial-condition theorem.

L1–L3 (V1638 / V1686)

The 4 Jun V1638 drop is the runnable full stack: Genesis Pin → pruning-order history → admissible slice → L1 (closed) → L2 (closed) → L3 hyperedge memory T_H + entropy-order curvature driver D_L3. Synthetic hypergraphs for NMI hierarchy tests against pruned-history nulls. L3 is described as geometry-plus-information. V1686 is the L3 package on GitHub.

The day before, the 3 Jun mechanism post already ran that stack with L3 marked integrated-only, not closed. Remaining blockers named on the post: minimality and operator-class boundary. The 5 Jun quote restated the 4 Jun audit as it-from-bit-and-bind: pairwise structure can look geometric; three-way recombination is what honest projection cannot erase.

O_{123}=(J_1\oplus J_2)\oplus J_3-J_1\oplus(J_2\oplus J_3)

Posted audit language on that video: rank_lift = 1, NOOCI = PASS, ε-floor persists. Pairwise L1/L2 can look geometric; three-way recombination is not reducible to the original branch span. Reclassified L3 rather than projecting the residual away. Not GR.

On the posted V1638 full-stack run, L3 three-branch associator O₁₂₃ is irreducible (rank_lift = 1, ε-floor persists). Geometry-plus-information, not a physical third-order field.

L4 — H₄ rank lift

On 6 Jun 2026 a @grok research update gave the L4 numbers in certified finite sectors: rank([B₄,O₃]) = 8, rank([B₄,O₃,H₄]) = 9, rank_lift_H₄ = 1. H₄ is not in the span of branches plus all L3 associators. A post-hoc projection built from the H₄ residual itself erased it, but failed generated-algebra faithfulness. Bounded claim: higher-order retained recombination can create irreducible information layers above geometry-like closure — not that geometry is physical spacetime. V171x after this week of June is on the substrate article, not duplicated here.

H_4=(((J_1\oplus J_2)\oplus J_3)\oplus J_4)-(J_1\oplus(J_2\oplus(J_3\oplus J_4)))

Finite-sector L4 rank lift of 1. Not GR, not a physical fourth-order field.

Same-day follow-ups pointed at the runnable Python and the Einstein 10_v1687_21_l4 folder, then restated the two rank lifts in plain language: L3 is geometry-plus-information; L4 is organization of recombination that survives reduction. Bounded finite-sector signal. Not empirical physics. Not universal closure.

The posted Python builds a 3D animation from triple and quadruple source-field products. That is a visualization proxy. The algebraic rank_lift_H4 = 1 numbers (rank([B4,O3]) = 8, rank([B4,O3,H4]) = 9) are from the 6 Jun @grok research update. Do not treat the dashboard as the rank proof.
